summary.en: Index Ventures is one of Europe's most successful and best-known multi-stage generalist VC firms, founded in Geneva in 1996 and now operating a transatlantic platform from London, San Francisco and New York with roughly €11.7B AUM. It has backed category leaders including Adyen, Revolut, Wiz, Figma, Datadog, Skype and Anthropic.

strategy.thesis: Largest Europe-only multi-stage platform, founded by Skype co-founder Niklas Zennström, using an operational team to help category-defining European founders scale from Series A through growth. Publisher of the annual State of European Tech report.

summary.en: Atomico, founded in 2006 by Skype co-founder Niklas Zennström, is the largest Europe-only multi-stage VC platform with roughly $4.7B AUM. It has raised seven funds (latest $1.24B in 2024), backed companies such as Supercell, Rovio, Klarna and Lilium, and publishes the annual State of European Tech report.

summary.en: Balderton Capital, founded in 2000 as Benchmark Capital Europe and independent since 2007, is a London-based multi-stage VC focused exclusively on European tech founders. It manages around $7B AUM, raised $1.3B in 2024, and has backed Revolut, GoCardless, Depop, Wayve and Dream Games.

summary.en: Northzone is a multi-stage (seed to growth) European VC founded in 1996, with offices across Stockholm, London, New York, Berlin and Amsterdam. summary.en: HV Capital (formerly Holtzbrinck Ventures), founded in 2000 and independent since 2010, is one of Europe's most prominent multi-stage VCs, based in Munich and Berlin with over €2.8B AUM. Its largest fund, Fund IX, closed at €710M. It has backed 225+ startups including Zalando, HelloFresh, SumUp and Flixbus.

summary.en: EQT Ventures is the early-stage venture arm of listed Swedish PE group EQT, founded in 2015 and based in Stockholm with advisors across six cities. It has raised about €2.3B across three funds (latest €1.1B in 2022, then Europe's largest early-stage fund), writing €2-50M checks into companies like Wolt, Einride, Netlify and Nothing.

summary.en: Lakestar is a Zurich-based multi-stage VC founded in 2012 by Klaus Hommels, managing over €2 billion across four early-stage and two growth funds, with offices in Berlin and London. An early backer of Spotify, Skype and Facebook, its portfolio spans deep tech, fintech, healthcare and logistics (Revolut, Isar Aerospace, Sennder).

summary.en: Creandum is a Stockholm-based early-stage (seed/Series A) generalist VC founded in 2003 by Staffan Helgesson, with offices in Berlin, London and San Francisco and about $2B AUM.
